investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ridgeix Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure centralindia (zones centralindia-1/centralindia-2/centralindia-3); network range 10.86.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ridgei-prod-centra (AKS); Object storage: provider-managed bucket/account for user content, accessed directly by backend services; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
